title: Bulls NBA Cup time. At least the courts look different?
text:
Bulls NBA Cup time. At least the courts look different? 
 BlogABull.com 
 Subscribe Sign in Bulls NBA Cup time. At least the courts look different?
 starting with a quick rematch against the Celtics
 Oct 30, 2026 Share The NBA Cup group play begins tonight. The Bulls will not be on Amazon Prime but will be on a new court, this one in Boston:
 The Celtics are the Bulls’ by-far toughest opponent in their group, with follow-up games against the Hornets, Wizards, and Hawks. Bulls were absolutely throttled by the Celtics just last week , we’ll see if tonight may be even worse with Celtics coach Joe Mazzula respecting The Cup ? 
 Same injury report as last time, besides Dailyn Swain (who’s not in the rotation) out with back soreness. Jalen Smith was on the injury report earlier today with a finger sprain, but is now listed as available.
